label: Viewing Angle & Composition
description: The full elevation x orientation matrix from the top-ranked prompts, each with its compositional payoff.

items.name: front-three-quarter
items.text: eye-level front three-quarter view, the classic stance shot with reflections rolling across the bodywork

items.name: low-front-three-quarter
items.text: dramatic low-angle front three-quarter view, the subject looming with reflections raking the lower panels

items.name: rear-three-quarter
items.text: eye-level rear three-quarter view emphasizing the haunches and exhaust detail

items.name: low-rear-three-quarter
items.text: low-angle rear three-quarter view, wide rear track dominating the frame

items.name: front-view
items.text: straight-on front view at eye level, perfectly symmetrical and confrontational, both flanks vanishing so one graphic face carries the frame

items.name: rear-view
items.text: straight-on rear view, symmetrical tail composition with the light strips reading as one clean graphic line

items.name: side-profile
items.text: clean side profile view, the entire silhouette line presented like a design drawing

items.name: low-side-profile
items.text: low-angle side profile skimming just above the ground plane, reflections doubling beneath

items.name: elevated-three-quarter
items.text: elevated three-quarter view from above eye height, showing the surface sculpture of the upper bodywork

items.name: top-down
items.text: steep top-down view flattening the subject into pure graphic shapes against the ground plane, its shadow the only clue to height

items.name: dutch-angle
items.text: dramatic Dutch-tilt angle, the horizon canted hard enough that static mass reads as motion, diagonals doing the work of speed

items.name: extreme-wide-close
items.text: extreme wide-angle from arm's length, the nearest surfaces ballooning toward the viewer while the far end rushes off to the vanishing point

items.name: through-foreground
items.text: framed through out-of-focus foreground elements, a soft dark vignette of blur layering the frame with stolen-glance depth

items.name: reflection-composition
items.text: composed around a mirror surface, the subject and its reflection sharing equal weight

items.name: wide-establishing
items.text: a wide establishing shot placing the subject small within the whole location, geography stated before anything else
items.text_short: wide establishing shot, subject small in the location
